holiday_calendar.source_method: Generate recurring PUBLIC dates with python-holidays, observed=True, verify the recurring rules, and add officially dated nationwide federal elections in both countries as operational calendar controls.

official_rule_checks.BR: Lei 662/1949 as amended by 10.607/2002, Lei 6.802/1980; annual federal holiday calendars confirm Good Friday dates. Fixed statutory dates remain on their legal dates; no national substitute date is added by the package.
official_rule_checks.MX: Ley Federal del Trabajo Article 74(I-VIII) as in force through 2022; first Monday in February, third Monday in March, third Monday in November, and 1 December 2018 executive transition date are matched exactly.

holiday_calendar.included: Recurring PUBLIC calendar dates, observed Monday dates in Mexico, and nationwide federal election days in both countries.
holiday_calendar.excluded: State/local holidays, municipal religious holidays beyond the recurring country calendar, administrative optional days, Carnival/bridge days outside the PUBLIC category, and state/local-only elections.
holiday_calendar.known_coverage_limit: This indicator does not represent all local schedules, hospital-specific staffing, bridge days, or every state/local election-related closure.

official_sources.title: Lei 662/1949, updated by Lei 10.607/2002
official_sources.supports: National fixed holidays, including Tiradentes and Finados in the current wording.

official_sources.title: Lei 9.093/1995
official_sources.supports: Framework for civil and religious holidays; Good Friday is recognized in annual federal holiday calendars.

official_sources.title: TCU Portaria 28/2018
official_sources.supports: 2018 federal holiday calendar and Good Friday date.

official_sources.title: Ministry of Planning Portaria 444/2018 for 2019
official_sources.supports: 2019 federal holiday calendar and Good Friday date.

official_sources.title: Federal District 2020 official holiday calendar
official_sources.supports: 2020 national holiday dates, including Good Friday; local and optional days are excluded from this calendar.

official_sources.title: TCU Portaria 14/2021
official_sources.supports: 2021 federal holiday calendar and Good Friday date.

official_sources.title: Federal Government 2022 holiday calendar
official_sources.supports: 2022 federal holiday calendar and Good Friday date.

official_sources.title: Lei 10.607/2002, revocation of Lei 1.266/1950
official_sources.supports: Revokes the earlier statute declaring nationwide election days holidays. Brazilian election dates are included separately as operational calendar controls, without assigning a statutory holiday classification.

official_sources.title: Ley Federal del Trabajo, Article 74, last amendment through 2021
official_sources.supports: Mandatory rest days, Monday-observed February/March/November dates, six-year executive transition day, and ordinary election day.

official_sources.title: INE 2018 federal election calendar
official_sources.supports: Federal election day, 1 July 2018; added under LFT Article 74(IX).

official_sources.title: INE 2021 federal election calendar
official_sources.supports: Federal election day, 6 June 2021; added under LFT Article 74(IX).
